sections.content:
We still see rectangle M at same location (rows ~??). The board hasn't scrolled? The moves didn't affect anything? Perhaps the rectangle cannot move because border blocks? But earlier moving up caused game over after many ups (maybe hitting top border). So moves are moving rectangle until hitting border causing game over. Our recent moves (UP, LEFT) didn't cause game over, maybe because still within bounds. But rectangle still at same coordinates? Let's check M boundary again after moves; still same. So perhaps moves are moving the rectangle but segmentation boundary remains same because M is the rectangle shape itself, not its position. Actually boundary coordinates are absolute board positions; if rectangle moves, its coordinates should change. Since they didn't, maybe moves are moving the viewport but M stays fixed relative to board (so boundary unchanged). That suggests rectangle is stationary, and the board scrolls but segmentation still shows board coordinates unchanged because board content moves, not rectangle. So the rectangle is like a window onto board; moving changes which part of board is under it, but M object remains same location (the window). Thus we need to scroll board such that red region appears under rectangle, then ACTION7 toggles interior to white maybe causing something.
We need to detect when rectangle interior shows red region. The interior shows underlying pattern when not white. The interior color appears as white objects currently (2 white objects). Those likely correspond to interior being white (two white objects maybe top and bottom?). Actually white objects count 2 earlier. The interior maybe two separate white patches? The rectangle interior might be split by something.
We need to see what colors are under rectangle currently. Let's get the region under rectangle using M boundary to extract ascii slice. Use ascii and slice rows 36-41, cols 11-16.

To bring col 42 under rectangle column 11, need to move LEFT 31 (since 42-11 =31). So sequence: UP 17, LEFT 31, then ACTION7. Let's try that.
